title: Update Ralph Integration documentation
overview:
Incomplete documentation makes Ralph mode features difficult to understand and use.

**Motivation:** Ensures users can effectively utilize Ralph mode capabilities.

**Signals:** priority: low
problem_statement: Incomplete documentation makes Ralph mode features difficult to understand and use.
motivation: Ensures users can effectively utilize Ralph mode capabilities.
resolution_notes: Already implemented. Multiple Ralph mode documentation files exist: docs/ralph-mode.md (comprehensive guide with concepts, guardrails, progress tracking, gutter detection, usage examples), docs/RALPH_WIGGUM_LOOP.md (technical implementation details), and docs/ralph-integration-plan.md (integration planning). The README also references Ralph mode with links to the detailed documentation.
